newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stock market's five-day winning streak ends.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stock market's five-day winning streak ends.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended down on Wednesday after the key index had racked up huge gains in the past five sessions, brokers said. They said profit-taking emerged in some blue-chip issues to send the Nikkei average briefly below the 20,000 threshold in the afternoon.
The 225-share Nikkei average fell 132.02 points or 0.65 percent to 20,048.90. Its June futures slipped 110 points to 20,080.
"Profit-taking was expected," Ken Ishikida, Sanyo Securities general manager, said. "But the downside was very firm due to buyers waiting for dips."
